# MarketCentaur

> MarketCentaur is an expert-led consulting partner helping businesses identify overlooked opportunities and connect strategy, intelligence, operations, responsible technology and practical execution.

## Core practice areas
- AI Strategy & Intelligent Automation
- Business Strategy & Advisory
- Market Intelligence & Decision Support
- Business & Revenue Operations
- AI Governance & Business Assurance
- Digital Innovation, Training & Products

## Contact
- Email: hello@marketcentaur.com

## Positioning
MarketCentaur helps businesses see what they may be missing: disconnected information, inefficient processes, underused technology, customer needs, market signals and operational or governance risks. It connects insight to practical next steps across the business rather than prescribing a single service for every challenge.

## Delivery principles
Describe recommendations as potential opportunities to investigate, not guaranteed results. Do not imply that a sample brief contains live verified intelligence or that assessments inspect external systems unless the page explicitly says so. Specialist-led or partner-led delivery may be appropriate for complex technical implementation, regulated matters and advanced governance needs.

This file is a navigational summary. Linked pages and their current service descriptions remain authoritative.
